text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If the data used to train AI contains unfair patterns, the AI can make biased decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness means we must check these systems carefully to ensure they treat everyone equally, regardless of race, gender, or background. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects large amounts of personal data. Transparency is equally important: people should understand how and why an AI makes a certain choice. Finally, responsible AI development requires ongoing testing, human oversight, and clear rules. By focusing on these principles, we can create technology that helps society while protecting individual rights and building trust.
